# Page Transitions with WebGPU and VanillaJS

This tutorial shows you how to build interactive page transitions with WebGPU and VanillaJS.

![tutorial Still](/public/images/tutorial-still.webp)

[Article on Codrops](https://tympanus.net/codrops/?p=116944)

[Demo](https://tympanus.net/Tutorials/PageTransitionsWebGPU/)

## Installation

```bash
# Install Dependencies
pnpm install

# Dev server
pnpm dev

# Build
pnpm build
```
